about: Copy this file to kit.local.json (which is never committed) and list the folders the demo session must not read: this repository, and anything else on this machine it could learn Sterling from. Write each as an absolute path in POSIX form with a leading double slash: on Windows, C:\Users\name\project becomes //c/Users/name/project. The kit build turns each into Read and Edit deny rules in the kit's .claude/settings.json.
